title: 2019 Panini Prestige #259 Montez Sweat NFL Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2019 Panini Prestige sports trading card features Montez Sweat, a rookie player for the Washington Commanders in the National Football League (NFL). The card is part of the base set and has a card number of 259. It is perfect for any football fan or collector looking to add to their collection. The card is manufactured by Panini and is a must-have for any fan of the sport.
